svg.title: Sathish Lella, AI Engineer
svg.desc: An animated night scene: a guide in a canoe drifts down a moonlit river toward a waterfall while paper lanterns and fireflies glow. The words read A walk through the forest, Sathish Lella, AI Engineer, followed by LLM applications, RAG and GraphRAG retrieval, agents that plan and act, and secure multi-tenant SaaS.
